title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Fremont | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Fremont Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STATION ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Take another mode of transportation to another BART station. The closest station is Warm Springs/South Fremont.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to exit at another station. The closest station is Warm Springs/South Fremont.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Fruitvale | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Fruitvale Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORM 2 ELEVATOR (RICHMOND, MILLBRAE/SFO/DALY CITY DIRECTIONS)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 1 elevator to opposite platform. Go back to Coliseum and board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Lake Merritt and return to Fruitvale. Exit using Platform 1 elevator.
PLATFORM 1 ELEVATOR (DUBLIN, BERRYESSA DIRECTIONS)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 2 elevator to opposite platform. Go back to Lake Merritt and board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Coliseum and return to Fruitvale. Exit using Platform 2 elevator.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Lake Merritt | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Lake Merritt Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORM ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Walk, roll, or take AC Transit 0.6 miles to access the street elevator at the 12th Street station (located between 11th and 12th on Broadway).
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to exit at another station. The closest station is 12th St. Oakland City Center (0.6 miles).
STREET ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Walk, roll, or take AC Transit 0.6 miles to access the street elevator at the 12th Street station (located between 11th and 12th on Broadway).
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to exit at another station. The closest station is 12th St. Oakland City Center (0.6 miles).

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For MacArthur | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - MacArthur Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORMS 2 AND 4 ELEVATOR (SFO/MILLBRAE/DALY CITY, BERRYESSA DIRECTIONS)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 1/3 elevator and go back to Rockridge or Ashby to board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to 19th St. Oakland and return to MacArthur. Exit using Platform 1/3 elevator.
PLATFORMS 1 AND 3 ELEVATOR (ANTIOCH, RICHMOND DIRECTIONS)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 2/4 elevator and go back to 19th St. Oakland to board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Rockridge or Ashby and return to MacArthur. Exit using the Platform 2/4 elevator.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Millbrae | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Millbrae Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STREET ELEVATOR FROM THE EAST PLAZA
Can't enter station: Take the elevator in the BART parking garage to access the walkway to the station concourse.
Can't exit station: Exit the station using the elevator in the BART parking garage.
CALTRAIN ELEVATOR - WEST PLAZA TO CONCOURSE
Can't enter station: Access the station from the opposite (East Plaza) side.
Can't exit station: Exit the station from the opposite (East Plaza) side.
PLATFORM 3 ELEVATOR (ALL DESTINATIONS)
Can't enter station: Use the Caltrain Platform 4/Northbound elevator.
Can't exit station: Use the Caltrain platform 4/Northbound elevator.
CALTRAIN ELEVATOR - CONCOURSE TO NORTHBOUND PLATFORM
Can't enter station: Use the BART Platform 3 elevator.
Can't exit station: Use the BART Platform 3 elevator.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Milpitas | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Milpitas Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORM 1 ELEVATOR (BERRYESSA DIRECTION)
Can't enter station: Use the SF/Richmond platform elevator on the opposite platform. Take BART to the Warm Springs Station, then board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to the Berryessa station and then return to Milpitas. Exit using the SF/Richmond platform elevator.
PLATFORM 2 ELEVATOR (MILLBRAE/SFO/DALY CITY/RICHMOND DIRECTIONS)
Can't enter station: Use the Berryessa platform elevator and take BART to the Berryessa station, then board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to the Warm Springs Station and then return to Milpitas. Exit using the Berryessa platform elevator.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Montgomery St. | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Montgomery St. Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STREET ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Use the Embarcadero Station street elevator at Market and Drumm streets (0.3 miles/ 4 short blocks). Go to the island on Market at Battery/Bush to take bus to Market at Main.
Can't exit station: Continue on train to exit at another station. The closest stations are Embarcadero (0.3 miles) and Powell (0.4 miles).
PLATFORM ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Use the Embarcadero Station street elevator at Market and Drumm Streets (0.3 miles/ 4 short blocks). Go to the island on Market at Battery/Bush to take bus to Market at Main.
Can't exit station: Continue on train to exit at another station. The closest stations are Embarcadero (0.3 miles) and Powell (0.4 miles).
